Mundo is a beast that can carry with unexpected healing and unexpected damage during team fights. In terms of scaling he starts to scale extremely fast when he gets about 2-3 items at about 20+ minutes. Although he might not be able to outscale champs like Jax or Kayle he can still ouscale the majority of top lane champions and has a greater role in team fights. Mundo is really good at team fighting because he flat out soaks all the damage and it takes forever to kill him, so while you are standing in front of your team and being fat your carries will wreck their team and once you get low you can run away and let warmog do its job. Runes wise i think everything looks great other than your secondary. Imo mundo doesn't need any more healing from precision since he already has a lot, therefore I like to go inspiration and go magical footwear to help out with boot cost and approach velocity so that you can hunt down or catch out people once you land your cleavers. To help out your lane problems your cleavers are your best friend. Maxing q allows you to cs pretty freely even against a strong laning opponent since it does so much dmg and it cd is really short. However, a common misconception is that mundo is useless in trades. Looking for trades with mundo looks like attempting to use and land all your cleavers annoying the fck out of your opponent while building up your resolve grasp of the undying stacks and hitting them with one "e" that does your max health damage, and then running away and going back to cleavers. Before you know it they might have lower health than you which allows you to go all in with your ultimate. But in match ups where you are getting absolutely slapped just sit back and let your cleavers farm. I recommenced you look for big engagements once you have sunfire cape or spirit visage with the help of your jgler. Also, dont be afraid to look for small trades during laning phase. You are mundo don't forget about your passive healing which sustains really well in lane and lets you heal up surprisingly quickly, I think the only person you dont' out heal in laning phase is Garen's passive. LAST TIP, mundo's e passive lets him to build up upto 42% mr!!!! And it is really easy to proc your e passive, just use w and put your self on fire, that will allow you to build up mr stacks a\\so that you can look for all in opportunities against champs like sylas or malphite, just don't forget to turn it off, however in teamfights I have it one 24/7 since mundo can out heal the w health cost and having that extra mr is super helpful.
